**About‑Us – Faded Archive**  

Faded Archive is a Manchester‑based shop that creates made‑to‑order t‑shirts from start to finish.  
Each shirt is hand‑printed on 100 % cotton using eco‑friendly inks, so you can shop with confidence that your style has minimal impact on the planet.  
Our design team spins fresh ideas every month, and you can request custom artwork or tweak any existing tee. Every order is produced only when you place it, so there’s never a stock queue – just a clean, personalised workflow from Manchester to your doorstep.  

---

**Logo colour suggestion**  
Use a muted charcoal (#4A4A4A) as the primary hue. It keeps the brand understated, pairs well with bright print colours, and looks contemporary on both digital and print media.
